The dose was administered in the incorrect route/site, was of lower than recommended volume, was administered before 24 weeks gestation, was administered less than 14 days before birth, was not the Pfizer/Abrysvo or Moderna/Mresvia product, had preparation errors prior to administration, or had storage issues.
